what: Pressing the menu button on the floating header unfolds a white panel, clipped to show only the header height (56px), downward in place into the full menu. The panel turns on at .25s, .15s later the clip opens down over .8s cubic-bezier(.77,0,.175,1), and the backdrop (ink 60%) is laid .25s later. On close the clip first folds back to header size, and .7s later the panel and backdrop turn off, vanishing as if rolled into the header

options.dur: Unfold duration (sec), default .8 — shorten toward 0 to open immediately
options.fade: Panel and curtain fade-in duration (s), default .25
options.bar: Header row height visible when folded (px or CSS length), default 56
options.ease: Expand curve (four cubic-bezier numbers or a CSS name), default 0.77,0,0.175,1 (original power3-inout)
options.--fx-gap: Board outer margin — overlaps the same spot as the header row (via style), default 24px 40px
options.[data-fx-part=toggle]: Open button (menu button in the header)
options.[data-fx-part=drawer]: Drawer covering the screen — veil and panel inside
options.fx:open · fx:close: Fires from the element on open and close — things like scroll lock are set by the caller
